title: Taste of the World Cup: Morocco
description:
Date: Monday, June 29 | TBD vs. Morocco 6 PM PST

Catch Morocco's next World Cup match on the big screen at Casablanca or at one of the many Kick It viewing locations across Los Angeles!
Find a viewing location near you: https://kickit.lacity.gov/

What makes a Moroccan restaurant feel like home, even thousands of miles from Morocco?

As Los Angeles welcomes the world for the 48-team World Cup 2026, the city becomes a vibrant showcase of global cultures and authentic flavors. Through food, communities connect, stories are shared, and every nation brings a taste of home to Southern California.

In this episode of A Taste of the World Cup: Morocco, we visit Casablanca Moroccan Kitchens, where traditional hospitality, rich spices, and authentic Moroccan cuisine create an unforgettable cultural experience in the heart of Los Angeles.

Discover how LA is celebrating the World Cup—one match, one story, and one meal at a time.
